 Who Plays Jason Duval In GTA 6?
 By   Zak Wojnar 
 Nov. 18, 2026 9:13 pm EST 
 Rockstar Games

 Preferred Source

 In Hollywood, there's a special honor that comes with being "number one on the call sheet," or the lead actor in any given project. That honor surely extends to the realm of video games, especially a game as high-profile and cinematically ambitious as "Grand Theft Auto 6."
 Back in 2008, Michael Hollick played protagonist Niko Bellic, though a pair of DLC expansions added two new playable anti-heroes, Johnny and Luis, who were portrayed by Scott Hill and Mario D'Leon, respectively. In 2013, "Grand Theft Auto 5" took a different approach, with three protagonists in the main game, played by Shawn Fonteno, Steven Ogg, and Ned Luke.
 Once again, the series mixes things up with "Grand Theft Auto 6." This time around, there are two protagonists, Jason and Lucia, a criminal power couple looking to survive and thrive in the complex and dangerous underworld of modern day Vice City. Lucia is played by Manni L. Perez and has already earned herself a nomination at Geoff Keighley's The Game Awards. But what about Jason? Who plays the other half of the playable "Grand Theft Auto 6" roster?
 Who is Dylan Rourke?
 Rockstar Games/YouTube 
 Actor Dylan Rourke plays Jason in "Grand Theft Auto 6." Rourke, whose career stretches back to 2013, has a background across stage, screen, and improv. Most immediately, you might recognize him from three episodes of "Station 19" as EMT Todd, as well as a different role in an episode of sister show "Grey's Anatomy." He's also popped up on episodes of series like "Shooter" and "911: Lone Star."
 On stage, he played Happy Loman in a California production of "Death of a Salesman," alongside Rob Morrow and Robert Adamson. The role of Happy had previously been played on Broadway by the likes of Harvey Keitel, Finn Wittrock, and Stephen Lang.
 Rourke also has experience in the world of improv and sketch comedy, having performed with the Groundlings, the Upright Citizens Brigade, and Second City, all esteemed groups on the comedy scene. He even performed with the legendary Fred Willard as part of The MoHo Group in Los Angeles.
 Dylan Rourke is the right actor for Jason Duval in Grand Theft Auto 6
 Rockstar Games/YouTube 
 With his resume in mind, it seems that the character of Jason Duval is in good hands with Dylan Rourke. On one hand, the "Grand Theft Auto" series is a rough-edged film noir crime story inspired by the works of director Michael Mann. On the other hand, it's a goofy satire of Americana with a fondness for lowbrow and raunchy humor.
 It's a unique tone that Rockstar has arguably struggled with over the years. Some fans complained that "Grand Theft Auto 4" was too grim and serious for its own good, while others felt the exact opposite regarding "Grand Theft Auto 5." Arguably, the tone was fully nailed with 2018's "Red Dead Redemption II," and early reviews suggest that "GTA 6" is an unbelievable achievement that builds off of that storytelling foundation.
 Given The Game Awards buzz regarding Manni L. Perez's role as Lucia, it looks likely that the chemistry between the protagonists will be a noteworthy highlight of "Grand Theft Auto 6."
